title: Influence and singleton Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let each coordinate bias $p_i$ lie in $(0,1)$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be monotone. For every coordinate $i$, its influence under the product distribution with coordinate biases $(p_i)$ equals the standard deviation of the biased sign at $i$ times the biased Fourier coefficient of the real-valued sign function $f$ on the singleton set $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to signs
